full_bank_proxy_ranking.method: Official Magic ext2spice cthresh0 full-bank export. Sum all signed incident SPICE C records per bitline; every raw zero/negative record is retained in counts. Checked bijective BL prefix normalization. Junction capacitance is not in this metal-C total.
full_bank_proxy_ranking.resistance_proxy: Rjoin=.104ohm/sq*(Lmetal2+Lmetal3+Lmetal4)/.38um +15ohm*(via2_count+via3_count); Rarray=.104ohm/sq*array_length/.38um; score=Cincident*(Rjoin+.5Rarray). Geometry-derived proxy, not automatic distributed-R extraction.
full_bank_proxy_ranking.qualification: Ranks all1280 full-bank metal-C/geometry-R load proxies. Does not prove worst transient delay over every row, coupling state, PVT, junction charge, or full-bank current.
full_bank_proxy_ranking.drain_count_qualification: Independent real-index drain population, not a junction-charge measurement. Highest metal-C/geometry-R candidate can differ from highest connected-drain population; neither alone proves worst transient.
full_bank_proxy_ranking.control_qualification: Full-bank PC/allWL incident signed metal capacitance only. Intrinsic device gate/channel capacitance remains in the transistor models, not these explicit interconnect-C sums.

fullbank_vs_crop_capacitance.qualification: Exact signed pair sums from official fullbank export and actual selected joined-subbank crop. No cap delta added to simulation. Neither sign of incident-C delta nor equality proves conservative transient behavior, actual global control timing, fullbank current or distributed parasitic equivalence.
